description: Fourteen 7×7 Pixel motifs for sharing, watches, platform use and combinations. Proposed rules are not entitlement decisions.

entries.label: Signal Relay
entries.evidence: Needs an authenticated, deduplicated share ledger
entries.visual_story: A cyan broadcast arrow rising from a transmission base.

entries.label: Broadcaster
entries.evidence: Needs qualified share receipts; an opened share sheet is not proof of publication
entries.visual_story: Cyan transmission banks, white pulses and a violet antenna.

entries.label: Prismatic Signal
entries.evidence: Needs a qualified holocard share event
entries.visual_story: A tiny iridescent card, white frame, blue core and pink foil.

entries.label: Signal Scout
entries.evidence: Own authenticated active watchlist; rule proposal
entries.visual_story: Green eye outline with a cyan iris and blue pupil.

entries.label: Orbit Watch
entries.evidence: Own authenticated active watchlist; rule proposal
entries.visual_story: Purple orbit, cyan compass points and a golden central signal.

entries.label: Watch Matrix
entries.evidence: Own authenticated active watchlist; rule proposal
entries.visual_story: Nine connected cyan nodes converge on a white hub.

entries.label: Claude Ember
entries.threshold: 10M accepted all-time processed tokens on Claude
entries.evidence: Accepted non-overlapping Claude telemetry; proposed threshold
entries.visual_story: An amber radial ember with a gold core.

entries.label: Codex Core
entries.threshold: 10M accepted all-time processed tokens on Codex
entries.evidence: Accepted non-overlapping Codex telemetry; proposed threshold
entries.visual_story: Blue terminal brackets, a white core and a cursor underline.

entries.label: Claude Ascent
entries.threshold: 100M accepted all-time processed tokens on Claude
entries.evidence: Accepted non-overlapping Claude totals; proposed threshold
entries.visual_story: An amber staircase with a golden cumulative-volume base.

entries.label: Codex Stack
entries.threshold: 1B accepted all-time processed tokens on Codex
entries.evidence: Accepted non-overlapping Codex totals; proposed threshold
entries.visual_story: Two blue terminal stacks containing white output and cyan context.

entries.label: Dual Engine
entries.threshold: Meet the 10M platform milestone on Claude and Codex
entries.visual_story: Amber and blue loops connected by one white bridge.

entries.label: Trinity Engine
entries.threshold: Meet the 10M milestone on three platforms
entries.visual_story: Purple, cyan and amber engines linked by a white triangular relay.

entries.label: Platform Mosaic
entries.threshold: Accepted telemetry from four distinct platforms
entries.evidence: Distinct accepted platform lineage; no double-counted windows
entries.visual_story: Four colored platform tiles, each with its own central aperture.

entries.label: Signal Connector
entries.threshold: Qualify for both a sharing and a watch milestone
entries.evidence: Independent authenticated share and watch milestones
entries.visual_story: Two cyan communities joined through a white bridge.
